create_Downsample1D: create a Downsample1D layer to downsample 1D tensors using average pooling or convolution
create_Downsample2D: create a Downsample2D layer to downsample 2D tensors with optional normalization and convolution
create_FirDownsample2D: create a FirDownsample2D layer to downsample 2D tensors using FIR filtering with optional convolution
create_KDownsample2D: create a KDownsample2D layer to downsample 2D tensors using a fixed Gaussian-like kernel
use_downsample_2d: use the downsample_2d function to downsample a batch of 2D images with an FIR filter
